name: AP_CROSS_CURRENCY_RATE_GT
description: This table contains temporary information for Cash Requirement Report.It is introduced to avoid the twice scan of the AP_INVOICES_ALL and AP_INVOICE_PAYMENTS_ALL and help to offer the required information in the before trigger of the Cash Requirement report execution .

columns.name: PAYMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of payment (must be same as INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE or have a fixed rate relationship)

columns.name: INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code used on the invoice.

columns.name: CROSS_CURRENCY_RATE
columns.description: Exchange rate between invoice and payment

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Unique process identifier

columns.name: INVOICE_ID
columns.description: Unique invoice identifier.

columns.name: PARTY_NAME
columns.description: Name of this party

columns.name: INVOICE_NUM
columns.description: Unique number for supplier invoice.

columns.name: BASE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Functional currency code associated with the ledger.

columns.name: PAY_GROUP_LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: Groups a category of suppliers or invoices for single pay run. For example, employees, merchandise, nonmerchandise, government, domestic, and international.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: Date when the invoice or installment is due for payment.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_DATE
columns.description: Date first discount is available

columns.name: SECOND_DISCOUNT_DATE
columns.description: Date second discount is available

columns.name: THIRD_DISCOUNT_DATE
columns.description: Date third discount is available

columns.name: AMOUNT_REMAINING
columns.description: Invoice amount remaining for payment

columns.name: GROSS_AMOUNT
columns.description: Gross amount due for a scheduled payment

columns.name: DISCOUNT_AMOUNT_AVAILABLE
columns.description: Discount amount available at first discount date

columns.name: SECOND_DISC_AMT_AVAILABLE
columns.description: Discount amount available at second discount date

columns.name: THIRD_DISC_AMT_AVAILABLE
columns.description: Discount amount available at third discount date

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Ratio at which the principal unit of one currency is converted into another currency for an invoice.

columns.name: ALWAYS_TAKE_DISC_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if available discount for supplier will be taken, regardless of when invoice is paid. Valid values are Y or N

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: PAYMENT_NUM
columns.description: Number used to identify a payment.

columns.name: WFAPPROVAL_STATUS
columns.description: Status of invoice in the Invoice Approval Workflow process. Valid values are from AP_WFAPPROVAL_STATUS lookup type.
